facts.fact: Lovable says you can start for free, and its plans are priced by credits rather than by projects or seats.
facts.quote: You can start for free, and plans are priced by [credits](https://docs.lovable.dev/introduction/credits-and-usage), not by projects or seats.

facts.fact: Lovable states that a workspace holds projects, members, billing, and a shared pool of credits.
facts.quote: holds projects, members, billing, and a shared pool of credits

facts.fact: Lovable states that each project lives in exactly one workspace.
Lovable states that it holds SOC 2 Type II certification.
Lovable states that it holds ISO 27001:2022 certification.
Lovable lists AIUC-1 as a security, safety, and reliability standard for AI agents that it is certified against.
facts.quote: AIUC-1, the security, safety, and reliability standard for AI agents

facts.fact: Lovable states that it is GDPR compliant.
Lovable states that projects can be synced to GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket through Git sync.
facts.quote: can be synced to GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket with

facts.fact: Lovable lists two-factor authentication (2FA) as part of its secure authentication for accounts.
Lovable lists data usage controls and data opt-out options as part of its platform security and governance features.
facts.quote: Data usage controls and data opt-out options

facts.fact: Lovable's community on Discord is open to all plans, according to the Lovable docs welcome page.
facts.quote: The community on [Discord](https://discord.gg/lovable-dev), open to all plans.

facts.fact: According to the Lovable docs welcome page, direct support from the support team is available on paid plans.
facts.quote: Direct support is available on paid plans.
